purpose: Prioritize work using local data availability without exposing paths, filenames, headers, timestamps or measurement values.

discovery_scan.interpretation: Keyword-level discovery only; no candidate is admitted without role, unit, synchronization and reuse attestation.

controlled_schema_scan.interpretation: The screened controlled roots contain component/station-side signals but no attested synchronized station-to-vehicle cohort.

private_station_archive.interpretation: Large local station-side evidence is available for P1 pressure, cascade and recharge diagnostics; it must not be presented as full-loop validation.

p0.action: Obtain a privacy-safe three-event station-to-receiving-vessel pilot with common time, station/dispenser pressure, delivered-gas temperature, mass flow/transferred mass and protocol phase.
p0.why: This is the only open gate that directly controls station-to-vehicle full-loop validation.

p1.action: Continue station-side pressure/cascade/recharge replay and separately develop spatial/line-dynamics models for public actual-hydrogen failures.
p1.why: The local archive is substantial enough to work immediately without waiting for P0.

p2.action: Keep LLM evidence-boundary, HIAD casebook and manuscript work independent of P0 data arrival.
p2.why: These tasks do not require raw vehicle rows and should not block engineering progress.

claim_boundary: This is an aggregate schema and availability scan. It is not a validation score, parameter fit, safety-distance result, full-loop evidence or IJHE readiness decision.
